-- dialect: postgres
-- Northfield Coffee Roasters, abandoned cart flow: who abandoned in the 24 hours before the run (audit and backfill of the native trigger)
-- Trigger: started checkout (checkout_started). Goal: placed an order (order_completed).
-- Entry: checkout_started at least 1 hour(s) ago with no order_completed since; one per person per day.
WITH triggers AS (
  SELECT t.user_id, MIN(t.event_at) AS started_at, MIN((t.properties ->> 'checkout_id')) AS ref
  FROM track_events t
  WHERE t.event_name = 'checkout_started' AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.event_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY t.user_id, CAST(t.event_at AS DATE)
),
stops AS (
  SELECT s0.user_id, s0.order_at AS event_at, s0.order_id AS ref FROM orders s0 WHERE s0.status = 'completed' AND s0.user_id IS NOT NULL
),
abandoned AS (
  SELECT tr.user_id, tr.started_at, tr.ref, MIN(st.event_at) AS next_stop_at
  FROM triggers tr
  LEFT JOIN stops st ON st.user_id = tr.user_id AND st.event_at >= tr.started_at
  GROUP BY tr.user_id, tr.started_at, tr.ref
  HAVING MIN(st.event_at) IS NULL OR MIN(st.event_at) > (tr.started_at + INTERVAL '60 minutes')
)
SELECT u.user_id, u.email, a.started_at, a.ref, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.started_at)) / 3600.0) AS hours_since,
       u.email_consent_at IS NOT NULL AS email_consent,
       u.sms_consent_at IS NOT NULL AS sms_consent,
       ((('x' || substr(md5(u.user_id || ':northfield_coffee_cart_abandon_1h'), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int) % 100) AS holdout_bucket,
       ((('x' || substr(md5(u.user_id || ':northfield_coffee_cart_abandon_1h'), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int) % 100) < 10 AS in_holdout
FROM abandoned a
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
WHERE a.started_at <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '-60 minutes') AND a.started_at > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '-1500 minutes')
  AND (a.next_stop_at IS NULL OR a.next_stop_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  AND ((('x' || substr(md5(u.user_id || ':lmm_global'), 1, 7))::bit(28)::int) % 100) >= 5
ORDER BY u.user_id

Add two properties to it where it is sent: holdout_bucket = first 7 hex digits of md5(user_id + ':northfield_coffee_cart_abandon_1h') as an integer, mod 100, and in_holdout = holdout_bucket < 10. experiment.sizing: about 351 entrants a month (DEMO DATA), 31.3% return within 10 days with no flow (DEMO DATA), 20% relative lift (6.3 pts) worth acting on: 508 holdout entrants at 10%, 14.5 months of entries plus the 10-day outcome window, so the read lands about 14.8 months after launch (engine/measurement/stats.py feasible --entries-per-month 350.7 --holdout 0.1 --baseline 0.3132 --mde-rel 0.2 --outcome-window-days 10)
experiment.read_after: not inside 12 months at this volume (it would take about 15 months): keep the holdout, report against a pre/post baseline, and label every result directional

readout_floor.rule: at least 30 entrants and 5 expected conversions per arm, at the baseline and at the treatment rate (the readout refuses smaller arms)

feasibility.recommended_design: the holdout will not reach a readable sample inside the horizon. Use a pre/post baseline, label it directional, and watch an operational signal instead; do not report a lift percentage

feasibility.randomization_unit: account (company or workspace) where the buying unit is an account; entrants in one unit are not independent, so set design_effect = 1 + (entrants per unit - 1) x ICC

experiment.decision_rule: Keep the flow when the 95% interval for (treatment minus holdout) rate of order_completed lies above zero and the guardrails hold. experiment.srm_rule: At every look, test the split against 90/10 (lcm readout --expected-holdout 0.1). A chi-square p below 0.001 means assignment or logging is broken; read nothing until it is fixed.
experiment.peeking_policy: One planned read on the date above. Earlier looks check sample ratio and guardrails only; no early stop for a good-looking lift.
